question.text: Under SEBI (Foreign Portfolio Investors) Regulations, 2019, who grants the certificate of registration to a foreign portfolio investor?

answer.text: The designated depository participant (DDP) on behalf of SEBI
The Ministry of Finance, Government of India
SEBI directly through its regional offices

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the SEBI (FPI) Regulations, 2019, the designated depository participant (DDP) grants the certificate of registration to the FPI on behalf of SEBI. The registration is permanent unless suspended, cancelled, or surrendered. The Trap: RBI, the Ministry of Finance and SEBI regional offices do not issue FPI registration; the function is delegated to DDPs acting on behalf of SEBI. Note: The DDP-on-behalf-of-SEBI route is the registration channel; ongoing compliance obligations are layered on top of that registration.
